title: Expose existing GitHub context while keeping unapproved attachment publication blocked
problem: After automatic approval rejected the proposed public attachment export, complete the independent navigation and coordination repair using existing GitHub sources only.
baseline: Supersedes the unadopted CONTEXT-ROUTE-20261112 proposal after rejected public upload. The initial proposal is preserved in a private review checkpoint. Existing greg/path.json, source records, claims and completion maps remain canonical; raw attachments are excluded.

alternatives.name: Existing GitHub links with explicit access limits
alternatives.description: Publish only navigation to already-readable canonical sources, existing roadmap and live ownership.
advantages: No private attached payload is published
alternatives.revival_evidence: Retain this scoped route; raw export is a separate explicit public-publication decision.

alternatives.name: Public attachment export
alternatives.description: Publish the eleven original texts and manifest in the public repo.
advantages: Would supply raw access to repo-only workers
disadvantages: Automatic approval rejected this action without explicit approval for this payload and public audience
alternatives.revival_evidence: Explicit founder approval naming the eleven texts and this public repository; no workaround or indirect upload.

alternatives.name: Do nothing until raw export is approved
disadvantages: Blocks independent safe navigation repair unnecessarily
alternatives.revival_evidence: A genuine source dependency makes the independent navigation inaccurate.

do_nothing_option.expected_outcome: Entrants continue reconstructing context from PR bodies and unavailable source titles.
disadvantages: Known discoverability gaps and missing raw access remain

pass_1.intended_outcome: Complete useful navigation and ownership repair with already-public sources; keep blocked attachment publication out of scope.

advantages.statement: Expose existing complete source and roadmap paths without waiting for an unrelated publication decision
advantages.amplified_value: Workers can select owned next steps while missing raw context remains explicit.

disadvantages.statement: Readers could confuse navigation with completed raw-source ingestion
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Remove all attachment payload/manifest/index; state the access gap and rejected export in the public record.

disadvantages.statement: A dated route may become stale
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Link canonical path and live board; retain exact pins as provenance and require refresh on resume.

disadvantages.statement: Entry edits collide with existing workers
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Exclude START_HERE; do not edit #206/#152/#193 branches; give their owners a precise handoff.

disadvantages.statement: More documentation can add bureaucracy without benefit
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Extend existing navigation; add no runtime/checker; test a fresh reader and measure later rework before claiming benefit.

comparisons.baseline: Keep the current claims and roadmap owners.
comparisons.simplest_viable_alternative: Existing GitHub links plus explicit source-access boundaries is the smallest route that is currently authorized.
comparisons.strongest_competing_architecture: The raw source packet offers access but is blocked until explicit public-export approval.
comparisons.reversible_experiment: Publish a navigation-only child draft of #196, test newcomer discovery and hand exact pins to existing owners.

rejected_alternatives.rejection_reason: #152/#193 already own it; another PR would duplicate their concern.
rejected_alternatives.revival_evidence: Existing owner explicitly hands over that concern or an authorized maintainer resolves the split.

rejected_alternatives.name: Retry the rejected raw upload through another route
rejected_alternatives.rejection_reason: Would bypass the automatic approval rejection. No such retry is authorized.
rejected_alternatives.revival_evidence: Explicit approval of the original public payload and destination, followed by the ordinary reviewed action.

pass_2.attack_summary: Attack the navigation-only route for overstated source access, stale truth, owner collisions and unobserved adoption. Compare with stopping everything and with the separately blocked raw export.

new_weaknesses.statement: A read receipt could be presented as proof of real comprehension or compliance
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Require observed fresh-reader answers and receiver action; keep universal/client adoption unproven.

new_weaknesses.statement: A historical census plus a current source packet may look like conflicting complete inventories
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Keep the 93-item census historical and label the packet as only the eleven attachments exposed to this task.

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.review_trigger: Moved head, new correction or changed gate.

pass_2.final_design: Extend AGENTS/BACKCAST/INDEX and a dated access/propagation record using existing GitHub sources only. Keep initial proposal and eleven-source archive private, no public upload retry. Use existing board/receipts/roadmap owners; protected adoption remains separate.

residual_risks.risk: Default clients and organs may not adopt
residual_risks.mitigation: Give existing owners exact immutable handoffs and record pending acknowledgments.
residual_risks.review_trigger: Authorized adoption and actual client entry.

residual_risks.risk: Historical chats outside this packet remain unavailable
residual_risks.mitigation: State exact missing scope; use source provenance and request only decision-critical missing context.
residual_risks.review_trigger: A decision depends on an unavailable source.

residual_risks.risk: Repo-only workers still lack the eleven raw attached texts
residual_risks.mitigation: Use existing canonical sources and exact missing-access record; request explicit public-export approval only for that concrete payload.
residual_risks.review_trigger: Explicit decision on the eleven-source public payload.

dissent.handling: Adversarial concern retained: only a bounded discoverability experiment is supported; no universal-compliance claim. Five roles above are implementer self-review perspectives, not five independent agents. Actual read-only child audits/reviews are identified separately in the PR.

entries.position: Do not call draft navigation project-wide installation
entries.rationale: Main and consumer entry remain unadopted
entries.evidence_threshold: Authorized merges plus observed normal entry and receiver handoff
entries.review_trigger: Any claim that all workers now comply

migration_plan: Publish only navigation based on existing GitHub sources; append verified board navigation without reconstructing lost history; hand exact pins to existing #196/#206/#152/#193 owners. Do not retry raw attachment publication without explicit approval.

steps: Close the unmerged navigation draft or revert only its scoped navigation changes; retain the private source and initial decision checkpoints.
If rejected, restore only the navigation append to the captured prior board heading
Preserve historical sources, loss report, comments and unrelated worker work

kill_criteria: Any authority or runtime change appears
An unresolved overlapping owner is overwritten
The rejected attached-source payload is included in a public retry without explicit approval
decision_owner: Context-route implementer under the current founder-authorized reversible preparation scope only; separate protected adoption remains pending with the existing integrator/founder
review_trigger: Resume, moved head, failed link, owner objection, actual fresh-worker handoff, or a separate explicit decision on raw public export
